text: Carpentry relies on wood and implements to build skill. First, apply varnish to shield the material and add a lustrous surface suitable for any interior. Once this layer hardens, focus shifts to joints, which are essential for structural integrity and lasting performance. Joints require careful construction to maintain stability over decades. Although saws and sanders perform the work, the carpenter's hands direct the shaping process. Through patience, accuracy, and proper equipment, a builder converts raw lumber into durable works of art designed to endure.
